I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message: "Thanks, Hollis. Noted: expense reports are due this Friday, October 16." The message was a reminder rather than a request, so a short acknowledgement was all it needed.

I worked out the date myself rather than looking it up: October 14, 2026 is a Wednesday, so "Friday" is October 16. I didn't look up any expense policy or deadline records.
